description.value:
You don't kill so much as accelerate what was already coming. Wounds spoil, blood sours, and the air around your target starts smelling like the inside of a sickroom.

SPOILAGE — your decay damage lingers as persistent rot rather than resolving all at once.

cinderfall.incomplete: Converting a spell's up-front damage into persistent damage is a per-spell system.damage.kinds change on each individual spell (as seen in real pf2e's own grim-tendrils.json/phantom-pain.json, which bake persistent damage into the spell's own damage-kinds array at authoring time), not something a single class-feat-level passive rule element can retroactively apply across every future Verse spell you might cast. No selector converts "this spell's damage" into "persistent" at the feat level.
